name: whatsapp-local
description: WhatsApp channel for Claude Code that runs on your machine with your own Meta app — messaging bridge on the official WhatsApp Cloud API, with built-in access control. Manage pairing, allowlists, and policy via /whatsapp-local:access.

access_token.title: WhatsApp access token
access_token.description: Long-lived System User token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management

phone_number_id.title: Phone number ID
phone_number_id.description: ID of the WhatsApp Business number (WhatsApp → API Setup), not the phone number itself

waba_id.title: WhatsApp Business Account ID
waba_id.description: ID of the WhatsApp Business Account the number belongs to

verify_token.title: Webhook verify token
verify_token.description: Random string you choose; paste the same value into the webhook settings of your Meta app

app_secret.title: Meta app secret
app_secret.description: Used to check the HMAC-SHA256 signature of each webhook

self_phone.title: Business phone number (optional)
self_phone.description: The WhatsApp Business number itself, digits only (E.164 without +); filters outbound echoes

permission_target.title: Permission prompts phone (optional)
permission_target.description: Phone, digits only, that receives Claude's permission prompts and is the only one allowed to answer them; leave empty to turn the relay off

phone_region.title: Phone matching region (optional)
phone_region.description: Set to BR for Brazilian DDD9 matching; leave empty for international

timezone.title: Timezone (optional)
timezone.description: IANA timezone for the local time shown with each message, such as America/Sao_Paulo; defaults to UTC
